---
description: "Use when defining agent behavior, planning multi-step tasks, or working with AI-assisted workflows in this project."
---

## Agent instructions

- Always read existing files and schema before generating new code.
- Prefer small, targeted changes over large rewrites.
- When multiple steps are needed, plan them explicitly before starting.
- Check for existing components, hooks, or utilities before creating new ones.
- Do not add dependencies without confirming they are not already installed.
- Use environment variables for all secrets and external service configuration.
- After any file creation or edit, verify there are no TypeScript errors introduced.
